tasks.task: Open the Meet Our Team page from the navigation menu and look at the order of the provider cards.
tasks.expected: The cards run Dr. Natarajan (Internal Medicine), Dr. Reyes (Family Medicine), Dr. Okafor (Pediatrics), Dr. Vasquez (Dermatology), Dr. Webb (Family Medicine), Dr. Chen (Pediatrics), Dr. Hardin (Sports Medicine) — years of experience descending, with the 15-year tie putting Natarajan before Reyes and the 8-year tie putting Vasquez before Webb alphabetically — clearly not the shuffled order the providers were originally given in.

tasks.expected: Only Dr. Reyes and Dr. Webb remain visible, with Dr. Reyes (15 years) listed before Dr. Webb (8 years); the other five providers are no longer shown.

tasks.task: On the Meet Our Team page, find Dr. Vasquez's card.
tasks.expected: Her card shows Dermatology, 8 years, a $210 new-patient visit fee, Tuesday as her only on-site day, and a waitlist badge that looks clearly different from the Accepting badge on Dr. Okafor's card.
